summary_bullets: Harden Python ship re-entry so validated resumes restore counters, branch identity, PR state, and durable mode flags before PR or CI work.
Prevent unsafe resume fallthrough on detached, mismatched, or protected checkouts while preserving blocked rebase-continuation state.
Cover resume classification, counter persistence, postmerge completion, durable flags, and CI monitor routing with focused Python tests.
commit_message:
Harden Python ship resume state

Restore persisted CI counters and durable mode flags before validated Python ship resumes, classify open/merged/done state with checkout and PR-head validation, and keep unsafe or unsupported resumes out of fresh work.

Add focused acceptance coverage for resume counters, branch hydration, checkout refusal, forked-target PR-only resumes, postmerge completion, run-log resume readers, and CI monitor bail routing.
